operations.research_note: State v. Willis Hester, 47 N.C. 83, pp. 83–86: indictment, not guilty plea, and trial before Bailey confirmed. September 1854 confinement predates observation and cannot establish admission. Execution-date conflict remains under review. Biography, notes, dates, and photos preserved.
operations.name: Willis Hester

expected.charges: Aiding a runaway slave; the alleged offense occurred in Orange County and the trial was moved to Chatham County.
expected.convicted: Yes — convicted after a change of venue to Chatham County, North Carolina.
expected.sentence: Death by hanging. Executed at Pittsboro on May 5, 1855.
